name: awakened shrub
desc: An awakened shrub is an ordinary shrub given sentience and mobility by the awaken spell or similar magic.
languages: one language known by its creator

special_abilities.name: false appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the shrub remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.

actions.name: rake
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) slashing damage.

lore:
The *Frutex Vivus*, commonly known as the Awakened Shrub, is a testament to the forest’s latent will. These sentient thickets are primarily found in ancient, mana-soaked groves or the overgrown courtyards of forgotten mages. To the uninitiated, they appear as mere boxwood or holly, yet they possess a quiet, brooding consciousness.

Unlike the more aggressive Shambling Mound, the Shrub is a patient, opportunistic predator. It does not hunt; it waits. By rooting itself along well-trodden paths, it mimics mundane flora. When a weary traveler rests against its boughs, the Shrub subtly shifts, its branches tightening like a slow-motion snare. It seeks not meat, but the rich minerals left behind as it smothers the unwary.

Local woodcutters speak of "The Whispering Green," believing these plants are vessels for the spirits of children lost to the wilds. Folklore warns that to prune a wild shrub without offering a prayer is to invite a silent, leafy stalker to follow you home. They are the forest’s eyes—lowly, overlooked, and ever-drifting through the undergrowth on roots that have learned to walk.
